## Case Studies
- [Enterprise Crypto Data Lake](https://lukasrozado.com/projects/enterprise-crypto-data-lake): multi-account ingestion, shared rate limiter, Bronze/Medallion model.
- [Unified Banking Ledger Platform](https://lukasrozado.com/projects/unified-banking-ledger-platform): merged PIX and ledger reconciliation pipelines.
- [Financial Reconciliation Pipeline](https://lukasrozado.com/projects/financial-reconciliation-pipeline): hybrid API + CSV anti-join reconciliation.
- [Multi-Chain Ledger Integrator](https://lukasrozado.com/projects/multi-chain-ledger-integrator): EVM/Solana raw RPC ingestion with self-healing reconciliation.
- [Institutional Custody Integrator](https://lukasrozado.com/projects/institutional-digital-asset-custody): multi-region ingestion orchestrator for crypto custody.
- [BaaS Financial Settlement Data Sink](https://lukasrozado.com/projects/baas-financial-settlement-data-sink): multi-bank settlement data centralization.
- [Predictive Pipeline & ML](https://lukasrozado.com/projects/predictive-pipeline-ml): end-to-end quant trading engine with 42-feature model factory.
- [OTC Desk Reconciliation Pipeline](https://lukasrozado.com/projects/otc-desk-reconciliation-pipeline): fuzzy-matched ETL from an unkeyed operational spreadsheet.
- [Fiscal Document Consolidation Pipeline](https://lukasrozado.com/projects/fiscal-document-consolidation-pipeline): monthly XML+PDF fiscal document consolidation.
- [LCK Dataset (public proof)](https://lukasrozado.com/projects/lck-spring-2024-dataset): public, verifiable Kaggle dataset.

## Writing
- [Um monitoramento que afirma que deu sucesso, mas não valida](https://lukasrozado.com/writing/monitoramento-que-afirma-sucesso-mas-nao-valida): PT, 2026-08-26.
- [A monitor that reports success without validating](https://lukasrozado.com/writing/a-monitor-that-reports-success-without-validating): EN, 2026-08-26.

## Key facts (auditable)
- Enterprise Crypto Data Lake: >99.9% uptime, tens of millions of records/year, full backfill since account inception (some since 2019).
- LCK Spring 2024 Dataset: 10.0/10 Kaggle usability score, 300+ downloads, CC BY 4.0, publicly verifiable.
- Predictive Pipeline & ML: >68% predictive accuracy across multiple seasons.
- Financial Reconciliation Pipeline: batches up to 50k records, anti-join self-healing reconciliation.

## Note
All case studies except the LCK dataset are anonymized for confidentiality. Metrics are auditable but client names are not disclosed. The LCK dataset is public and verifiable on Kaggle. This site is last updated 2026-08-27; check page-level dateModified in JSON-LD for per-page freshness.
